['Senvion SA '].company_description: Senvion SA operates in the wind turbine manufacturing industry and offers a range of wind turbine models, including the 3.7M144 EBC and 3.6M118 NES, designed for low and high wind sites, respectively. The company also provides operations and maintenance services for wind turbines, with a dedicated team of over 90 personnel in India.

['R\u00f6chling SE & Co. KG '].company_description: Röchling SE & Co. KG is a plastics engineering company headquartered in Mannheim, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. The company has three divisions: Industrial, Automotive and Medical. Currently Röchling employs 11,245 people in 90 locations across 25 countries (North- and South America, Europe and Asia), with annual sales of €2.207 billion in 2021.
